settingsDiagnostics.consent: I understand the file may still contain sensitive details, and I agree to share it with the Prusa team.
settingsDiagnostics.downloadHelp: Download saves a diagnostic file on your device. It does not send the file to Prusa. To share it later, attach it to your support ticket.
settingsDiagnostics.extensionsHelp: Such as the log lines and readings your printers sent. They are scrubbed like the server's own logs.
settingsDiagnostics.hint: Review the file before sharing it
settingsDiagnostics.intent.existing.labe: Add to a report I already sent
settingsDiagnostics.intent.new.label: Report a new problem
settingsDiagnostics.intro: A file for the Prusa support team. It holds this server's logs and configuration. We scrub them, but sensitive details may still remain.
settingsDiagnostics.modules: Include what modules wrote to their error output
settingsDiagnostics.modulesHelp: Scrubbed, but a module can print anything. Leave it off unless a module is failing.
settingsDiagnostics.part.browser: This browser's recent errors and warnings
settingsDiagnostics.part.config: The configuration, with secrets and addresses removed
settingsDiagnostics.part.crash: The last crash on record, if any
settingsDiagnostics.part.modules: The state of each installed module, plus its error output if you opt in
settingsDiagnostics.part.printers: The connection state of each printer, without labels or addresses
settingsDiagnostics.sendFailed.busy: The Prusa beta portal has received too many files. Try again later.
settingsDiagnostics.sendFailed.busyFor: The Prusa beta portal has received too many files. Try again in {wait}.
settingsDiagnostics.sendFailed.notZip: The Prusa beta portal did not accept the file as a zip.
settingsDiagnostics.sendFailed.other: The Prusa beta portal did not accept the file. Download it and attach it to your report instead.
settingsDiagnostics.sendFailed.product: The Prusa beta portal does not take files for this product.
settingsDiagnostics.sendFailed.tooLarge: The file is too large for the Prusa beta portal. Leave out the module output, or download the file and attach it to your report.
settingsDiagnostics.sendFailed.unreachab: This browser could not reach the Prusa beta portal. Download the file and attach it to your report instead.
settingsDiagnostics.sendWhere: The file goes to the Prusa beta portal. You sign in there and attach it to a new report or to one you sent before.
settingsDiagnostics.title: Diagnostics
